title: Template:InfoGrid
text: A responsive grid of Template:Tl boxes. The cards sit in as many columns as fit and drop to one column on phones. Usage {{InfoGrid| {{InfoCard|title=Orbs|type=danger|tag=Dodge|Blue and red orbs fly out in flurries.}} {{InfoCard|title=Pull|type=control|tag=Crowd control|The boss drags everyone towards itself.}} }} min (optional) is the narrowest a card may get, in pixels. The default is 260. Use min=340 for cards that hold a Template:Tl. Needs Template:InfoCard and its styles Template:InfoCard/styles.css.
